note: Manistee NF rustic campground on the shore of Pine Lake (Manistee Co.); the east side of the lake is mostly private cabins, the federal west side swampy and long used by bald eagles. Shallow, gravel-bottomed swimming beach off the picnic area; boat access. Near the Big M cross-country ski / mountain-bike trails, the Pine National Scenic River and the Bear Track / North Country Trail area. --Claude
